title: Apply per-device block I/O limits on container update
body:
Related to #30167.

The Docker-compatible container update endpoint (`POST /containers/{id}/update`) currently ignores per-device read and write rate limits. It also accepts missing or invalid device paths, such as `/dev/null`, without reporting an error.

The endpoint should validate that each path refers to a block device and return HTTP 400 otherwise. It should apply the requested limits, preserve existing rules when the field is omitted or `null`, and clear only that field’s rules when passed an empty array (`[]`).

Translated from Serbian.

Fixes: #30312
